div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Locate the failing agent
trace guardrails → extractor → router → lane
chat_messages.data.intent names the lane

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Capture the failing case as a gold row
api/api/ai/<agent>/datasets/<name>.jsonl
input + expected label · split · difficulty · note

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Baseline it — expect RED
pypyr eval agent=<agent> show_errors=1

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Set the objective + tolerance
cheaper / faster model · new technique · approach
e.g. 'hold accuracy within 1pt at lower cost'

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Datasets ARE the benchmark
add cases only to probe a specific gap

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Version gate — ASK the user
edit in place vs fork a copy
(experiments → fork, for A/B + rollback)

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Edit current version in place
versions/<current>/

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Fork a new version
cp -r versions/vN versions/vN+1

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Apply ONE change
defect: smallest fix
experiment: pin cheaper model · new technique
prompts.py · agent.py · current.yaml model:

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Re-measure / A-B on the datasets
sample=25 fast → split=all full · llm=1 for a model swap
pypyr eval version=candidate vs baseline · history=1

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Goal met AND nothing regressed?
defect: case passes
experiment: quality within tolerance at lower cost

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Revert · form a new hypothesis

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Keep it
if forked → version: vN+1 (+ model:) in current.yaml

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Goal satisfied, or
hypotheses stopped moving it?

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Done — report before/after from eval_runs.jsonl
'tried, didn't beat the bar' is a valid outcome
